analysis.memo.oppPressHigh: They look set to press high up the pitch. There could be space in behind their defence.
analysis.memo.oppLineHigh: They look set to push their line up aggressively. There could be space in behind their defence.
analysis.memo.oppLowBlock: They look set to sit deep and close the space. Breaking through the middle won't be easy.
analysis.memo.oppShort: They play out from the back with short passes. Disrupt their build-up and chances will come — but if their defenders stay composed, the press gets bypassed.
analysis.memo.oppDirect: They get the ball forward quickly. Watch out for crosses from wide and second balls.
analysis.memo.weakTechnique: Their technique when building from the back is a weakness.
analysis.memo.weakShape: Their defensive shape tends to be loose.
analysis.memo.strongSpeed: Their forwards are quick. Pushing your line up could be risky.
analysis.memo.strongAerial: Crossing and aerial ability are their strengths.
analysis.memo.strongEnergy: They're a hard-running side. It could come down to stamina in the second half.
analysis.memo.targetMan: Their {name} is a target man. Expect plenty of crosses and aerial duels.
analysis.memo.playmaker: Their attacks start at {name}'s feet. Shut him down and you could break their rhythm.
analysis.memo.wingBack: Their {names} push high as wing-backs. That leaves space down the flanks behind them.
analysis.memo.finisher: Their {name} plays as a {role}, looking to finish inside the box.
analysis.memo.balanced: Expect a steady {tactics} approach from them, with no obvious weak spot. This will come down to quality and concentration, so we can play our own game.
analysis.noMatchup: No particular tactical matchup stands out against this side. It looks like it'll come down to quality and fitness.
analysis.disclaimer: This analysis is a prediction based on the opposition's usual approach. During the match they'll adapt to the scoreline.
